The place itself was clean and organized. I hope to come back some day in the future if I move back to PHL.

This was the most expensive groom I have ever had for my dog. It is double the amount I have ever spent on any dog. $360 for grooming is outrageous!!

This is one of the best Veterinarian that I have been to in a long time. I am very fortunate to find them. They are extremely professional, knowledgeable and friendly. I am definitely going to keep them for a long time.

Dismissive, liars and unprofessional.

Brought my cat here about an issue with her tongue. She was not able to drink or eat properly. Tongue control was minimal. Karwacki says "it must be a new way she's drinking" in a very obviously dismissive way and hands me antibiotics and that's the first visit. Started giving her the meds and reacts badly, no appetite or thirst (even though she was already barley eating or drinking). I texted Karwacki and told her the situation and was told to stop the meds. Then she prescribed her steroids instead, they don't do anything either. Then she suggests a teeth cleaning as an excuse to see inside her mouth. This was a blatant lie they were just looking for an excuse to upsell me. I get the teeth cleaning anyway for my cat. They find that I was right the whole time, something wrong with her tongue and suggested a CT scan. After the cleaning they tell me they have a hard time waking up my cat from the anesthesia. RED FLAG. Bring her home, a day later now she is drooling even more then before and still not able to eat or drink. The cleaning was unnecessary and just added problems to the main concern. Went to another vet and they were able to tell right away there is an issue with her tongue, no teeth cleaning, no anesthesia, no two different drugs suggested. They just want your money here and nothing else.

My Cat Spunky Deuce Tails was able to get an immediate appointment. They  diagnosed and treated him the same day. The cost was reasonable and the staff was awesome!
P.S. My cat is doing well.
Everyone is always very helpful and answers your questions. Environment is bright and clean so I feel comfortable with my cat receiving the care she needs.

Raya and I had a wonderful first visit at Heart + Paws Callowhill. The staff was all amazing and did their very best to make Raya feels as comfortable as possible for her first visit. We have definitely found our new vet in our new town.
Very friendly staff! Great with my dog. Did a great job cutting her nails.

my pup has recently been diagnosed with diabetes, which has not been an easy feat. Heart + Paw has been extremely helpful, understanding and flexible with appointments, conversations and management to help ease the stressors with this new diagnosis. Hi Firdous. At Heart + Paw, we aim to provide positive experiences at all times. Is there anything we could do to make it better? Please call us at (267) 388-1747!

The pricing is absolutely unreasonable and we were misled by the staff. We called in advance to find out approximately how much it was going to cost to have a check up and have my kitten vaccinated. A lot of “we’ll have to see” and when we pushed to know a number they said to expect up to 50$ per vaccine.

What they didn’t mention is the flat rate of 100$ for the appointment itself and 14$ for the disposal of medical waste which is not included in the appointment fee. This could have been mentioned given that it is a flat rate and not a “we’ll have to see” situation. If we had known, we would not have booked at this price.

I also went ahead and researched both treatments my kitten received and they were 20$ more (each) than other vets in the area.

I feel absolutely robbed and misled. I would not recommend this experience to anyone.
Thank you so much for sharing your thoughts and for trusting us to care for your pet! We are here for you.

We brought our four-month-old kitten to Heart + Paws for a simple wellness exam. Before the visit, I specifically called to ask what we needed to bring, and they told us to bring a fecal sample.

During the visit, we mentioned that we needed the exam results for our pet insurance. Weeks passed and we still received nothing. When we called to follow up, we were told that no fecal test was ever performed or charged.

Then why were we instructed to bring the sample in the first place? Paying almost $100 for a visit where they just briefly touched the cat is honestly unbelievable.

During the wellness exam, we were also told our kitten needed a booster vaccine. Because we couldn’t stay home to observe him that day, we were told it was totally fine to come back for the vaccine later — and that it would be the same price, just in and out with a technician (~$50).

But when we scheduled the vaccine visit, we were suddenly charged a technician exam fee + a ridiculous “disposal fee”, totaling $100 for ONE vaccine. Absolutely unreasonable.

And the front desk staff… extremely unfriendly. They never make eye contact, and asking about pricing gets you an eye-roll. No respect, no courtesy, and zero transparency.

This place clearly does not care about your pet and does not care about customers.
Between the inconsistent information, unclear pricing, and rude staff, we will never return. Save your time and go somewhere else.

I’m incredibly grateful to the phenomenal team at Callowhill and Dr. Karwacki at Heart + Paw for the care they gave my dog, Rivka. After her cancer diagnosis, they managed her palliative care thoughtfully and always centered her comfort and dignity.

When it was time to say goodbye, they created a calm, compassionate space that allowed her to pass peacefully and without fear. Their kindness made an unbearable moment gentler, and I’ll always be thankful for how they cared for her and supported us through her final weeks.

I like this place don’t get me wrong, but the pricing is insane and un-affordable. How is it that a neuter here is upwards of 600 dollars? I found a very nice vet north east that did the procedure and put in a micro chip for 100 dollars; and other places the most you’ll pay is 300. This vet is a scam.
Or how about the fact that I made an appointment for my cat to be checked for ringworm, but realized it was just cuts on his nose from another cat. Call to cancel it that morning— A NINTY DOLLAR cancellation fee!!! What the hell is that! And you want me to put down a 250 dollar deposit for my car to get neutered. I am a college student with two jobs, tuition and bills to pay, and decided to save a cat off the street who was bleeding and hurt— I shouldn’t be expected to pay NINTY DOLLARS as a cancellation fee, because my cat DOESN’T have ringworm.
NEVER GO HERE, there are such better options in the city, with employees with much more understanding, who ACTUALLY CARE about your pets. (Referring to the secretaries who all sound like they hate their jobs)

Edited review- it was 5 stars.

We’ve had a great experience with the veterinary team, especially Dr. Amber, and will continue coming here for vet care. However, I do not recommend the grooming services.

This is the third grooming visit in a row where the “complimentary” teeth brushing and ear cleaning were not done, despite me specifically requesting them each time. Nails are trimmed, but ears and teeth are consistently skipped, and I only find out after following up myself. It’s frustrating to be told at his vet visit that he needs dental care while the groomers repeatedly ignore tooth brushing.

We also had a previous groomer at this location who overcharged us and left our dog with cuts, leaving him uncomfortable for days. We switched groomers, and while the haircut was better, the teeth were still not brushed and once again we were led to believe all services were done.

For the price, this level of inconsistency is unacceptable. The grooming quality has gone downhill, even as costs have gone up. Happy to pay for whatever he needs, but 175 bucks and you can’t trust they did what you requested? We can certainly find a more trustworthy groomer.

My groomer, Lynnanne, was much more professional and attentive. I hope the receptionist was just having an off day- it was Monday morning after all.

I arrived 15 minutes late today for my dogs wellness exam and agreed to pay the $35 late fee.  No biggie.  But the assigned veterinarian Dr. Amber Karwacki was extremely nasty.  I dont know if it was because it was late in the day or she is over worked or was simply having a bad day but she was nasty.  I had 2 different techs come in the room that seemed all over the place and rushed. I mentioned during the intake process that my dogs anal glands may need to get expressed but wanted to wait until after he is examined. This tech took my dog back to get weighed.   A different tech came in the room and said another tech is going to begin expressing his anal glands.  I then asked to speak to the doctor since i already said i wanted to hold off until after he is examined.  I heard Dr. Karwacki scream through the door "Im not dealing this!" Then she opened the door and looked agitated then got nasty with me. She said "why do you keep asking for things?"We're already running behind cuz you were late!" I told her I didnt appreciate the way she was speaking to me and decided to leave.  No way in hell i was going to let anyone with that demeanor then give shots to my dog.  Perhaps she needs a vacation or time off because no one deserves to be treated like that. Definitely shocking as she has been pleasant on prior visits.  Today was like night and day.  Unfortunately I no longer feel comfortable bringing my dog back here.

Update 7/7/25. I checked my bank statement and noticed a $90.65 charge from Heart and Paw Callowhill.  I called and spoke to Naheema who said she was the manager for that location.  I asked her why I was charged since the appointment didn't take place nor was I ever informed that I was going to be charged and I also never received a payment receipt.  She informed me that the doctor "examined my dog in the back " so I was charged. She said "when your late examinations arent done in the examination room to save on time." I knew that was a blatant and outright lie. I asked her to send me a receipt for payment and visit summary which by the way you automatically get when an exam is completed. She sent me the $90 receipt of payment and a visit summary that states an exam was not completed and states I was charged $90 for a NO SHOW. So was I charged for an exam or a no show?? I then asked why I didnt get a visit summary or receipt for payment on the day of the "exam?" She said the system sometimes doesnt work.  Another lie.  Once I caught her in a lie she began getting defensive and started over talking me.  She then offered to reimburse me half of the amount. Naheema also laughed when I mentioned the bad interaction that I had with Dr. Karwacki. My issue at this point was not even the $90 but the back door shady practices and furthermore expressing valid complaints and concerns to the practice manager Naheema to just be laughed at and not taken seriously. Be very careful bringing your furry friends here for care.  Get everything in writing.  They are untrustworthy and will cover for each other. If they can be deceptive over something as small as this who knows what else they are capable of.

I really debated writing this review but for the sake of pet owners who go to this clinic please PLEASE get a second opinion if something feels off.

I took my cat into heart and paw back in 2022 when I first got to Philly around October. She had a small mass on her neck, just quarter sized at the time, and after multiple X-rays, an ultrasound, a cytology, and blood test they let me know it wasn’t cancer and was probably an infection or small trauma from a scratch she got before.

Well by the time February came around that mass grew to 3x the size and covered half her neck. After taking hundreds if not thousands of dollars from me and running around in circles for months did they let me know they had no idea what was going on. I went to a different vet and immediately they suggested a biopsy and let me know it was a rare form of cancer.

I trusted this clinic. The vet staff were always nice. I always felt welcomed and treated with kindness, however, due to their gross oversight I lost 5 months and I don’t even know how much money that could’ve been spent treating my cat. She passed July 2023, and it makes me sick wondering if she could’ve stuck around if I knew before.

Maybe it wouldn’t have changed a thing, maybe it would’ve changed everything; only thing for sure is that I will never know and it’ll haunt me forever.

Please get a second opinion for your pets.

I brought my cat here a few months ago with an eye infection. He received good care, and everyone was pleasant. The prescription they gave him cleared up his infection.

I'm an optician, so I am familiar with the cost of nuisance issues like this in humans. The cost to clear up pink eye in a cat here was more expensive than human care.

Additionally, the whole time they kept trying to push a $1000 teeth cleaning on me. The upsell was real. He then had to come back for a follow-up. Most small eye infections don't need a followup unless symptoms persist when it comes to human care.

Honestly, the whole place smacks of private equity.
